name: Bedlington Terrier

colours.name: Blue
colours.note: Born nearly black, lightens with maturity.

colours.name: Liver
colours.note: A warm brown; puppies start much darker.

colour_note: Each of the three is also seen with tan points. Swatch values are approximations for display, not part of any standard.

traits.label: Shedding
traits.note: Very low — the coat needs clipping instead.

traits.label: Energy
traits.note: Needs to sprint, not just stroll.

traits_note: The 1–5 figures are editorial summaries of the breed's reputation, not measurements.

health.headline: Copper toxicosis
health.detail: An inherited copper storage disorder in which copper accumulates in the liver instead of being cleared. Linked to the COMMD1 gene; a DNA test exists and responsible breeders screen for it.
